$comment: Committed, so every clone gets it. Pre-approves the commands a session
runs constantly, so work is not interrupted by permission prompts.
The line drawn: anything that cannot lose committed work or reach outside
the machine. Deliberately absent, so they stay a conscious choice —
git push, git reset --hard, git rebase, gh release, gh repo, and rm.
Also absent on purpose: anything that starts a wireproxy process or reads
~/.config/tubedepth/wireguard. Those touch VPN private keys and network
egress, and an agent should have to ask.
